name: Inko Kya Hi Pata Chalega
visual_description: Stand-up comedian Abhishek Upmanyu performing on stage at Canvas Laugh Club with the subtitle 'Inko kya hi pata chalega'.
usage_context: Used to describe secretly cutting corners, lying, or doing something deceptive assuming no one will ever notice or find out.
